text: Irina's new puppy arrives on Saturday. A cockapoo called Biscuit, and she's already bought three beds for him.
Jack starts at the council planning office next Monday. He sounded relieved more than excited after six months of looking.
Need to post Matilda's birthday card by Thursday at the latest, she's in Leeds now.

Coffee with Joanna this morning. Her cat Pepper has kidney trouble and the vet wants to see him again sometime next week. She's trying not to think about the cost, and her partner thinks they should get a second opinion. Pepper is thirteen now, so she's realistic about it, but she cried a bit when she told me. I said I'd go with her to the appointment if she wants company.
Kate got the promotion! Senior account manager from the first of the month. I should take her out for a drink to celebrate, maybe Friday.

Kerry is retiring at the end of the month after thirty-one years at the hospital. There's a do for her at the Crown on the 28th. Don't forget to chip in for the leaving present, Barbara is collecting.
Delroy's leaving drinks were cancelled because half the team has flu. He finishes on Friday regardless.
Jorge and his wife are fostering two kittens until early March. He showed me about forty photos.

Zeynep called. Her dad goes in for his knee operation next Tuesday and she's driving down to Bristol the night before. Her brother Ivan can't get time off, so it's all on her, and she's worried about her dad managing the stairs afterwards. She'll stay at least until the weekend. Ring her on Wednesday to see how it went.
Siobhan is very nervous about her first day as a deputy head tomorrow. Text her good luck tonight.
Pick up dog food, return the library books, book the car in for its MOT before the end of the month.
Adaeze mentioned she's vegetarian now, and she can't stand coriander. Useful for the dinner.
Kiri's rabbit, Clover, turns five on Sunday. Apparently there's going to be a cake made of carrots. I'm not making this up.

Bogdan has handed in his notice. He's moving to a start-up in Manchester in a fortnight and his boss took it badly. He's found a flat in Ancoats with a balcony and is excited about the change, although his girlfriend is staying here until her course finishes in the summer. Need to sort a leaving present before he goes, maybe a decent coffee grinder.
Lindiwe and her husband Hassan are celebrating ten years married this weekend. They're off to the Lake District for a few days.
Follow up with Phoebe about her interview at the museum. It was yesterday and I completely forgot to message her.
Juan's daughter Camila graduates from nursing school over the summer. He's so proud he's already booked the hotel.
Ivan works nights at the depot now, so don't call him before two in the afternoon.
Zara is struggling a bit since the redundancy. Her mum's been staying with her. I should pop round with some food one evening this week.
Graham told me his old collie Bess had to be put to sleep on Tuesday. Fourteen years. He was very quiet about it. Send him a card.
Anjali Patel starts her new job at the bank on Monday, the 3rd. Same building as her brother Nikhil, which she finds hilarious.
Jakub mentioned he'd love a decent pair of running headphones. His birthday is early next month.
Luis wants to meet up for lunch sometime next week. He suggested Wednesday or Thursday, either works for me.
Bao's first day at the vet surgery went well, she said. Nervous all morning, then fine once the first appointment arrived.
Salma's parrot escaped on Friday and came back on Saturday by itself. She's still shaking about it.

Marta is having her farewell lunch on Thursday at the Italian place. Everyone from the old office is invited, and I'm going. She's off to work for a charity in Kraków, near her parents, and starts there in early December. Her dog Fudge is going with her, which involved a frankly ridiculous amount of paperwork.
Ryan's partner Kate is expecting in April. He mentioned it very casually, as if it wasn't huge news.

Long call with Irina tonight. Biscuit has settled in, though he chews everything, including her work laptop charger. She's back in the office from next Tuesday and worried about leaving him alone for long. Her neighbour, Mrs Ahmed, has offered to let him out at lunchtime. Irina also said her sister Matilda is thinking of getting a puppy from the same litter. Remind me to send her the number for that trainer I used.
Jack's boss is retiring at Christmas and Jack has been asked to apply for the role. He's not sure he wants it. Interview would be in early January.
Send Joanna the photos from the barbecue.
Dr Chen said Pepper's blood results are better than expected. Joanna is thrilled. Check in with her next week anyway.
Barbara starts volunteering at the animal shelter on Saturdays. She's loving it so far. Her granddaughter goes with her sometimes.
I'm visiting Mum and Dad this weekend and driving back Sunday night. Need to sort a present for Dad's birthday before then.

Delroy has a second interview on Tuesday for the logistics manager job. He seemed calm about it. It's a step up from his current job, more money and a shorter commute, and his wife Barbara is keen for him to get it because he's been unhappy since the restructure. Ask him on Wednesday how it went.
Kerry's son Jorge just got his first job as an electrician's apprentice. Starts the week after next.
Zeynep, or Zee as everyone at work calls her, is getting a cat once she moves into the new flat at the end of the month. She wants a ginger one.
Thinking about adopting a dog in the spring. Look into the rescue places near work.

Adaeze's brother Kiri is flying in from Auckland on Thursday for three weeks. She's taking him to see the family in Lagos at the end of the month, then he flies home in mid-November. She's had a mad week getting the spare room ready.
Bogdan and Lindiwe are hosting a housewarming on Saturday the 14th. Bring wine, and they said not to bring flowers because of the cat.
Hassan's mum isn't well again. She's been in hospital since Sunday. He's going up to see her tomorrow.
Phoebe got the museum job! Assistant curator, starts in January. Send congratulations and maybe a nice notebook.
Juan is a big Atletico fan and collects old football shirts. Worth remembering for Christmas.

Ivan's first week as team leader has been rough. Two people quit on Monday and he's covering their shifts. He hasn't seen his kids properly since Sunday, and his manager keeps sending emails at midnight. He says it'll calm down by the end of the month once the new starters arrive, but he sounded exhausted. Call him at the weekend just to check he's okay.
Quiet evening, nothing much to report. Finally finished the book.

Zara has a job interview next Thursday morning, her first since she was made redundant. She's really anxious about it. Don't forget to message her good luck on Wednesday night, and then ask how it went on Friday.
Graham's daughter Phoebe is starting at Edinburgh uni in September and he is already dreading the empty house.
Anjali's dog Rolo had his stitches out today. He's running around like nothing happened.

Met Jakub and his girlfriend Marta for a drink. They're moving to Glasgow sometime in the new year because she's been offered a lectureship there. Jakub is going to keep working remotely for now. They're going to miss the dog walks on the common, apparently.
Luis was promoted to head chef last week. I owe him a visit to the restaurant.
Bao has a hamster called Noodle and a cat who wants to eat him. Constant drama.
Salma Usman retires from teaching in July. Her last day is the 19th and the school is planning a surprise assembly. Don't mention it to her.
Note to self: Marta mentioned her mother loves orchids. Possible gift for the birthday later this year.
Ryan's stag do in Lisbon has been called off, the wedding is postponed until next summer. He sounded fed up.
Ring Kerry about the leaving collection by tomorrow.
Tomorrow: dentist at nine, then drop the parcel at the post office. Pay the gas bill before Friday.
Nikhil has started at the bank in the IT team. He hates the commute but likes his manager.

Jorge's dog Luna has had puppies, six of them, on Monday night. He's keeping one and asked if I knew anyone who wanted the others. Ask Siobhan, she's been talking about getting a dog for ages. They'll be ready to go to new homes in early December.
Camila mentioned she's allergic to cats, so the dinner will have to be at hers rather than Irina's.
Kate's leaving party is next Friday. She finishes at the agency the following Wednesday and starts her maternity leave. Get a card for everyone to sign and organise flowers for the party.

Matilda called to say she's been made permanent at the library. She's been on rolling contracts for two years, so it's a big deal. Her girlfriend is taking her out for dinner on Saturday to celebrate, and her mum is coming down from Durham later in the month. I should send something small, maybe a plant for her desk.
